sources.title: PIMCOMP: An End-to-End DNN Compiler for Processing-In-Memory Accelerators
sources.read_depth: Reread selected fulltext methods,not every evaluation paragraph. Official README downloaded at commit0cfbfa55cca22fcfebdb8dcfc75420dcbbbbdf77;no execution.
sources.evidence: AGs share input;layout and scheduling iterate through profiler;GA jointly maps/replicates;backend emits primitives;profiler performs functional and timing simulation. README exposes instruction-by-instruction comparison against ONNX Runtime and pimsim-nn.
sources.boundary: Crossbar-template PIM with explicit partial accumulation/VFUs;does not establish ordinary NAND block/wave or opaque output-row ABI. General compiler+verification+cost loop is already prior.

sources.title: Fast-OverlaPIM: A Fast Overlap-driven Mapping Framework for Processing In-Memory Neural Network Acceleration
sources.read_depth: Reread architecture/performance model,ready-time transformation,whole-network search and controls. Not full evaluation/artifact execution.
sources.code: Customized Timeloop stated;no author project repository verified in inspected text.
sources.evidence: Mapping search includes producer/consumer readiness. Transformation sorts data spaces by input readiness and maps to resources while accounting for changed partial-sum movement. Uses overlap-aware and transformation controls and equal-runtime comparisons.
sources.boundary: Main evaluated backend is majority-based bit-serial HBM-PIM;not NAND ordinary-read service. Joint causal placement orready-time scheduling is not a new category.

sources.title: Stratum: System-Hardware Co-Design with Tiered Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM for Efficient MoE Serving
sources.read_depth: Reread expert partition/input reuse/execution text;earlier architecture/mapping audit retained;no simulator run.
sources.code: In-house simulator described;public runnable source not verified.
sources.evidence: Coordinates the two up partitions with down partition to keep activation ownership local;all PUs process activated experts sequentially;common input duplication is amortized;partial result gather overlaps next expert.
sources.boundary: Mono3D DRAM/NMP with local SFU/ring/reduction. Direct paired-GU/down and shared-input prior,but neither its units nor timing imply AiF capability.

sources.title: Cambricon-LLM: A Chiplet-Based Hybrid Architecture for On-Device Inference of 70B LLM
sources.read_depth: Reread architecture,2D atomic tiling/broadcast and timing-based workload balancing;not a full new evaluation read. This is Cambricon-LLM,not FlexLLM.
sources.code: Modified SSDsim/NPU simulator stated;author runnable artifact not verified.
sources.evidence: Native page-sized2D atoms are mapped across channels/cores. Shared-channel input broadcast changes aspect-ratio cost. Tiling minimizes input/result movement and balances NPU/flash read-compute time.
sources.boundary: Strong direct NAND-geometry/cost prior;not a complete-row,no-column-partial ordinary one-block work/depth frontier or physical per-row certificate in inspected sections.

sources.title: TileLens: Efficiently Using Large-Granularity Memory Systems with Transparent Two-Dimensional Memory Layout
sources.read_depth: Read these fulltext sections this round,extending prior abstract/introduction read. No source build or claimed paper-associated GitHub.
sources.code: No author artifact verified;same-name visualization/tool repositories are unrelated.
sources.evidence: Decouples static memory-tile shape from compute tile,derives address translation and alignment. SW path changes DSL descriptors;HW path extends TMA. Evaluated system also changes L2/MSHR/prefetch.
sources.boundary: HBF-fed GPU matmul,not in-flash dense GEMV. Granularity-aware transparent layout/address compilation is direct prior;new hardware support cannot be imported as existing AiF capability.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.read_depth: Reread original command/placement/block-split/software-evaluation passages;earlier full mechanism audit retained.
sources.code: Local kernel is timing metadata/dummy output;no native PE functional/RTL contract verified.
sources.evidence: Equal submatrices,sequential LSB placement;GEMV specifies full input dimension,block,offset,pages. Cross-block submatrix becomes separate commands;FIFO polled as outputs appear. Evaluation returns dummy vectors.
sources.boundary: Native command/block split and dense packing are existing design capabilities. Output dtype/scale/reset,valid-row/fringe behavior,FIFO and input broadcast remain unverified.

sources.title: RecFlash: Fast Recommendation System on In-Storage Computing with Frequency-Based Data Mapping
sources.read_depth: Reread primary page coaccess/timing/frequency/plane/cache methods;no artifact run. This exact v1title corrects earlier informal embedding-optimized wording.
sources.code: No author runnable code verified in inspected primary text.
sources.evidence: Remaps frequently accessed embedding vectors to improve page utilization;combines plane distribution andcontroller page cache;models command/address,array-read and dataout phases.
sources.boundary: Direct NAND page-packing/plane/frequency prior for SLS embeddings,not dense whole-row GEMV numerical contract or MoE work/depth compiler.

sources.title: A Hypergraph Based Approach to Declustering Problems
sources.read_depth: Earlier primary fulltext audit retained,not newly reread this round.
sources.evidence: Query frequency weighted max-device sum of item retrieval times;variable item size/capacity and step-function service allowed.
sources.boundary: Covers fixed-atom query-aware placement objective. Does not itself validate resharded matrix operator semantics or native NAND lowering;representability does not prove the entire system contribution absent.
